questions.Question_Text: Staff are aware of local mental health services that they can direct participants to if required.
Staff are aware of the needs and challenges facing each individual.
The organisation has strong partnerships with local schools and/or other social service providers.
Coaches who to contact within the organisation to get additional support for a participant.
Coaches have received training relevant to working with the vulnerable groups living in the community.
Coaches have opportunities to debrief or exchange with other coaches or staff about challenges at work.
The organisation delivers sport activities in spaces local to where the participants live.
The organisation uses digital tools effectively for communicating with participants.
The organisation has strong partnerships with local community groups and organisations.
The organisation has a diversity of income streams, and is not dependent on just one or two sources.
The organisation can support people who are financially disadvantaged to participate. e.g. waiving or subsidising membership fees, providing sports kit and equipment or providing transport.
The organisation has strong partnerships with funders and/or sponsors.
The organisation has a diverse board and decisions are made democratically.
The organisation has formal processes for capturing the ideas and views of participants and these influence decision making.
The organisation has strong partnerships with relevant federations or governing bodies.
The organisation is experienced in running activities outside the main location and without regular facilities.
The organisation has digital tools and methods for running activities remotely for participants.
The organisation has strong partnerships with other sport clubs and facility providers.
